title: Great Vacuum
text:
Great Vacuum. I have 7 kids and 2 dogs, so we really put vacuums to the max test around here. This is very lightweight. My kids have no problem lifting and using this vacuum. The vacuum works really well. It it very versatile and can be used for almost any scenario we could think to need a vacuum for. It works on both carpet and hard flooring. It has a pet hair attachment, which works well. I wish the wall mount was a more pleasant color, but it works well for its purpose.
My only real complaint is the battery life. It only lasts about 30 minutes before you need to plug it back in. So, if I get on a roll cleaning all the things right now, this cannot keep up with me. It is fine for spot cleaning or cleaning for short amounts of time. The power for the battery is great. No complaints with the power. Just wish the battery lasted a bit longer.
Update: I finally committed to hanging this bad boy on my wall. And to my surprise, it won’t charge on the wall hanger. I don’t know why. Everything is hooked up, plugged in, ready to go. It blinks like it is charging, but it doesn’t actually charge. So, I’m still having to use the charger out of the wall unit.

product_metadata.title: Kenmore 25.0V Lightweight Cordless QuickClean 2-in-1 Stick Vacuum, Motorized Pet PowerMat, Washable HEPA Filter, Detachable Hand Vac, 2-Speed Settings, Dust Cleaning Tools, Green
features: BARE-FLOOR SYSTEM: The microfiber system is perfect for hardwood, tile, laminate, low-pile area rugs or carpets, and more.
CHARGE ANYWHERE: Rechargeable 25-volt lithium-ion battery easily charges on wall-mountable charging/storage station or portable charging base.
LIGHTWEIGHT CORDLESS PORTABILITY: Under 6 pounds, 180° swivel steering, and fully reclines to reach deep under furniture or high above-floor with minimal effort.
ADVANCED HEPA CLEAN AIR TECHNOLOGY: A washable HEPA filter and cyclonic action trap and separate fine dust particles and allergens.
DUAL ACTION: Converts to a handheld vac for daily cleanups and hard-to-reach areas.
ACCESSORIES INCLUDED: crevice tool, dust brush, battery pack, and powerful motorized pet hair removal tool great for furniture, stairs, car interiors, dog beds, and more.
description: The Kenmore Elite Quick Clean cordless vacuum keeps your hard floors looking their best with minimal effort easily converts to a hand vac with the push of a button for small cleanups in tight spaces. Under 6 pounds, this multitasker uses powerful suction as it swivels reclines to clean under furniture all the places a full-sized vacuum can’t. Attachments include a motorized Pet Power Mate tool to remove stubborn pet hair from floors, stairs, upholstery, car interiors, more, a crevice tool/dust brush for tight spaces and blinds. The bare-floor nozzle uses a microfiber brush-roll to lift the smallest dust particles while cyclonic action HEPA filtration keeps dust allergens in the dust cup out of the air. When the job is done, the Quick Clean Cyclonic Multi-Vac stores away as effortlessly as it cleans on the wall-mounted charging station. For added convenience, charge where the power is with the portable charging base.
